name: dasatinib
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Myelosuppression and Bleeding Events: Severe thrombocytopenia, neutropenia, and anemia may occur. Use caution if used concomitantly with medications that inhibit platelet function or anticoagulants. Monitor complete blood counts regularly. Transfuse and interrupt dasatinib
interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Strong CYP3A4 Inhibitors: Dose reduction may be necessary. ( 2.3 , 7.1 ) Strong CYP3A4 Inducers: Dose increase may be necessary.
